text:
mia: Heads-up — planning a config change: introduce "apply_semaphore" to prevent concurrent applies per-tenant during snapshot restores. Need telemetry + console cues before rollout.
jordan: Agree. minimal metrics: config.apply.semaphore_acquired_total, config.apply.active_semaphores gauge, config.apply.duration_ms histogram. Tag tenant_id + operator_version.
sam: Ops: add an auto-pause if any apply > 8m OR 95p > 4x baseline. Also force-release API must be audit-logged and SRE-only.
mia: Console: show per-tenant semaphore state in preview, link to last 5 apply events. Feature flag rollout: 5 tenants -> 25 -> all, with 24h dry-run.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: config-operator/feat/semaphore to canary-3 at 2026-03-24T09:30Z. CI passing.
jordan: I'll draft the telemetry contract and push examples. sam: I'll update runbook. mia: PR incoming, tagging @jordan @sam
